senses.gloss: f. (cmp. μαργαρίτης, μαργηλίς &c., prob. of Semitic origin, cmp. רגג, רגרג) gem, jewel, pearl, mostly pl. מַרְגָּלִיּוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8b:6">Ab. Zar. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ואבן טובה וכ׳</he> in setting pearls and a precious stone (for an ornament), which is made the base (subordinate) to the other?—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:11">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> (expl. <he>צהר</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 6:16">Gen. VI, 16</cite>) <cite ref="M02522"><he>מרגלית</he></cite> a polished gem; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:7">Y. Pes. I, 27ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 23:6">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXIII</cite> <he>מ׳ אחת תלויה וכ׳</he> one jewel was suspended in the Ark which lighted up &c.; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:9">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:1:2">Y. Shek. II, beg. 46ᶜ</cite> <he>ויעשו אותן מ׳</he> why not let them exchange the coins (to be taken to Jerusalem) for a jewel … <he>שמא תזול המ׳</he> the jewel may fall in price.
<cite ref="Yoma 75a:19">Yoma 75ᵃ</cite> <he>לבן כמ׳</he> white as a pearl; a. fr.
